answers.ask: Grounded modern city, or something more stylized and comic-book?
answers.answer: Una ciudad moderna realista y sencilla, para que el balanceo libre sea el centro del juego.

answers.ask: Is swinging around the whole game, or is there something to do in the city?
answers.answer: El juego consiste en recorrer la ciudad y columpiarse libremente; no hacen falta misiones ni objetivos adicionales.

answers.ask: How far should the city run before it ends - and what stops the player at the edge?
answers.answer: Haz una ciudad grande pero manejable, de varios bloques y rascacielos, con límites invisibles en el borde del mapa para que el jugador no salga.

scene_prompt: Crea un mapa 3D de una ciudad moderna, realista y sencilla, grande pero manejable, extendida a lo largo de varios bloques urbanos. Organiza calles entre edificios altos y rascacielos, con una composición densa que ofrezca fachadas, azoteas y alturas para recorrer la ciudad balanceándose libremente. El borde exterior del mapa queda delimitado por límites invisibles.
agent_notes: Free web-swinging across a city is a free-running game, and Action is the genre that carries traversal-city and the Parkour Traversal preset for those places, so it leads even though the author confirmed there is no combat and no missions; nothing else is doing enough work to name a second genre, and this is not a showcase because the city is played across rather than looked at. traversal-city is the shape: a city built to be crossed over, rooftops and ledges sized for a moving player, streets below as the fallback, and its P2 is real here because the whole game is swinging through the volume above the street. I kept the preset's shape but dropped all three of its options as combat framing the author explicitly ruled out - cover-los and choke-bottleneck exist to shape fights, and hazard-kill would make the streets lethal in a game whose only activity is swinging over them. With no user to ask I took the author's answers as the whole brief: several blocks of plain realistic skyscrapers at settlement-density, no objectives, no finish, and an invisible barrier at the map edge, which no option covers and which the pipeline should place as a boundary rather than build as geometry.
